kernel.oracles: Both production implementations verify every returned full key and value, exact record counts, GC leaf count, and complete operation-allocation refunds. All six alternating pairs pass.

assertions: Peak residency does not exceed 64 MiB.

limitations: The common-prefix kernel is a deliberately wide synthetic stress case, not archive throughput.
